text:
Tier 4 assessment, first appointment.

39M. Weight 148 kg, height 1.78 m, BMI 46.7. Has been above 130 kg since his mid twenties.

Comorbidity: prediabetes with an HbA1c of 6.2%, obstructive sleep apnoea on CPAP since 2022, no
hypertension, no diabetes.

Admitted with a DVT after knee arthroscopy in 2019, treated with three months of rivaroxaban, no
recurrence. Thrombophilia screen negative.

He denies binge eating and there is no purging. The pattern is grazing.

Anaemic on today's bloods, Hb 11.4 g/dL, ferritin 18 ng/mL. Started on ferrous fumarate; this
will need rechecking before any surgery.

Psychology and dietetics assessments booked. If he completes the 12 week pathway and holds his
weight we would list him for a sleeve gastrectomy.

ENT clinic

Three years of nasal blockage, worse on the left, post nasal drip, intermittent anosmia.

Nasendoscopy: septum deviated to the left, mucosal oedema, no polyps, no pus today.

CT sinuses from May: Lund-Mackay 8, no bony erosion, no fungal features.

Chronic rhinosinusitis without nasal polyps, confirmed on today's nasendoscopy.

Failed maximal medical therapy including three months of intranasal steroid and two courses of
antibiotics.

Listed for functional endoscopic sinus surgery. He knows the bariatric team may want him to lose
weight first, and that the two waiting lists do not talk to each other.

He asked about his mother's nasal polyps and whether his are the same thing. Explained that she
had polyps and he does not.
